Use rhombus XYZW with $m\angle WYZ=53$, $VW=3$, $XV=2a-2$, and $ZV=\frac{5a+1}{4}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: XYZW is a slanted rhombus with diagonal YW drawn through point V, and the marked 53° angle at Y is between YW and YZ, i.e. ∠WYZ. From the text, the figure is a rhombus and m∠WYZ = 53°. Use the rhombus theorem that each diagonal bisects the angles at its endpoints. Since YW is a diagonal, it bisects ∠XYZ, so ∠XYW = ∠WYZ. Therefore m∠XYW = 53°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: diagonals XZ and YW intersect at V; V lies on YW, so ∠WYZ is the same as ∠VYZ, and ∠XYW is the same as ∠XYV. From the text, VW = 3, XV = 2a - 2, and ZV = (5a + 1)/4. Since XYZW is a rhombus, its diagonals bisect each other, so XV = ZV. Solve 2a - 2 = (5a + 1)/4 to get a = 3, hence XV = ZV = 4; also YV = VW = 3. A rhombus has perpendicular diagonals, so triangles XYV and ZYV are right triangles with legs XV = ZV and shared leg YV. Thus the two right triangles are congruent, making ∠XYV = ∠VYZ. Since ∠VYZ = ∠WYZ = 53°, m∠XYW = m∠XYV = 53°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个菱形 XYZW，顶点 X 在左上，Y 在右上，Z 在右下，W 在左下。两条对角线 XZ 和 YW 画出并相交于内部点 V。点 V 位于对角线 YW 上，因此射线 YV 与 YW 共线。图中在顶点 Y 处标出角 ∠WYZ 为 53°，即由 YW 和 YZ 形成的角。

推理：因为 XYZW 是菱形，所以它的对角线互相平分，因此 XV = ZV。题中给出 XV = 2a - 2，ZV = (5a + 1)/4，所以 2a - 2 = (5a + 1)/4。解得 8a - 8 = 5a + 1，3a = 9，a = 3。因此 XV = ZV = 4。又因为菱形对角线互相平分，VW = 3，所以 YV = VW = 3。菱形的对角线互相垂直，所以 △XYV 和 △ZYV 都是直角三角形，并且有 XV = ZV、YV 为公共边，因此两个直角三角形全等。于是 ∠XYV = ∠VYZ。由于 V 在 YW 上，∠XYV 就是 ∠XYW，∠VYZ 就是 ∠WYZ。已知 ∠WYZ = 53°，所以 m∠XYW = 53°。
